scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @study-lens/web" "npm run dev -w @study-lens/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @study-lens/core && npm run build -w @study-lens/web && npm run build -w @study-lens/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
